usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the RPN calculator to `main.wj`. I ran it in the interpreter on both examples plus a blank line and `-7 2 /`, and every output matched what the spec calls for. `-7 2 /` gave `-3`, so division truncates toward zero. I didn't run `wj build`, as instructed, so the compiled path is untested.

It reads all of stdin and skips blank lines. A line evaluates left to right and stops at the first err
